headline: Start immediately with up to 25 production accounts, but scaling requires 3 active external installs and a 10-day Marketplace review.
summary: HubSpot allows immediate external OAuth distribution with a hard cap of 25 customer portals and an unverified app warning. To scale further and remove the warning, you must undergo a free Marketplace review taking up to 10 business days. AI agents must specifically enforce user-level permissions or integrate via HubSpot's Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.
time_to_production: Immediate for first 25 installs; ~2 weeks for Marketplace listing to lift caps

oauth.pkce: Supported (S256) and strictly mandated for native integrations and remote MCP server connections.
oauth.refresh_tokens: Refresh tokens do not expire automatically. Access tokens are short-lived and expire after 30 minutes.
oauth.redirect_uri_rules: Must use https:// (except localhost), require valid domain names (no raw IPs), and match registered URLs exactly (up to 20 supported).
oauth.scopes: Space-separated strings. Optional scopes are silently dropped from the grant if the connecting account lacks tier access.

steps.title: Create Developer Account & App
steps.detail: Sign up for a HubSpot Developer Account, create a new project or app, and retrieve your Client ID and Client Secret.

steps.title: Configure OAuth Settings
steps.detail: Define redirect URIs and scopes in the developer portal or app-hsmeta.json. Ensure redirect URIs are strictly HTTPS.

steps.title: Test Authorization Flow
steps.detail: Initiate the OAuth flow. Connecting users must be Super Admins or have Marketplace Access permissions.

steps.title: Acquire 3 Production Installs
steps.detail: Distribute your app to at least 3 unique, external production accounts. Unlisted marketplace apps are capped at 25 installs.

steps.title: Generate API Activity
steps.detail: Ensure there is active API or webhook activity across the 3 production accounts in the rolling past 30 days to qualify for review.

steps.title: Prepare Documentation & URLs
steps.detail: Host a dedicated setup guide, Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, and an Install button landing page. Ensure they allow the HubSpot Crawler.

steps.title: Create Shared Data Table
steps.detail: Map every requested OAuth scope to a public Shared Data table explaining data flow directionality.

steps.title: Accept Partner Agreement & Submit
steps.detail: Formally accept the HubSpot Technology Partner Program Agreement and submit the app for ecosystem quality review.

steps.title: Await Quality Team Review
steps.detail: The HubSpot Ecosystem Quality team reviews the app. If feedback is issued, you have 60 days to remediate.

requirements.text: Apps submitting for a Marketplace listing must have at least 3 active, unique installs in unaffiliated production accounts with API activity in the past 30 days.
AI connectors must enforce user-level permissions or be built using HubSpot's Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server.
All submitted public URLs (Privacy Policy, Setup Guide, etc.) must not block the `HubSpot Crawler` user agent.
A public Shared Data table must be provided, mapping every OAuth scope to its data flow directionality.
The app name and logo must not use 'HubSpot', 'Hub', or the sprocket logo.

gotchas.text: Unreviewed apps configured for Marketplace distribution are strictly hard-capped at 25 customer portal installs.
Users installing an unreviewed third-party app will encounter an explicit unverified app banner and confirmation dialog.
Access tokens expire quickly after 30 minutes, whereas refresh tokens last indefinitely.
Public OAuth apps are throttled to 110 requests per 10-second rolling window per installed account.
If a user lacks access to an optional scope (e.g. an Enterprise tool on a Free tier), HubSpot automatically drops the scope from the authorization grant without failing the install.
OAuth discovery metadata including authorize endpoint, token endpoint, and S256 PKCE support are live and confirmable.

blockers.how_to_proceed: Ensure your app only requests scopes that are actively utilized and explicitly documented in your Shared Data table.

blockers.issue: Review rejection due to inaccessible URLs.
blockers.how_to_proceed: Check your firewall or bot-protection services (like Cloudflare) and whitelist the `HubSpot Crawler` user agent for all submitted URLs.

blockers.issue: Review rejection due to missing test credentials.
blockers.how_to_proceed: Provide sandbox test credentials or demo accounts in your developer setup instructions so reviewers can test the OAuth flow end-to-end.

agent_can: Draft the Shared Data table mapping OAuth scopes to functionality.
Draft Privacy Policy and Terms of Service documents.
Configure redirect URIs and scopes in the developer portal or app-hsmeta.json.
Perform automated API requests to generate the required 30-day API activity for beta installs.
Test that all public URLs return HTTP 200 to the `HubSpot Crawler` user agent.
you_must: Sign up for a HubSpot Developer account and register the app.
Secure the first 3 active external production installs to meet the Marketplace review prerequisite.
Accept the HubSpot Technology Partner Program Agreement.
Submit the app for the final Ecosystem Quality review.

key_claims.text: Marketplace-distributed apps are hard-capped at 25 installs before approval.
There are no submission or listing fees for OAuth apps in the HubSpot Marketplace.
The HubSpot Developer Platform portal is live and accessible.

open_questions: Will reviewers consistently reject apps that lack demo test credentials, as anecdotal community reports suggest?
